{{DISPLAYTITLE:vaspcheckfd.h5}}

The [[vaspcheckfd.h5]] file is used to store the displacements for a restartable finite differences calculation when using {{TAG|IBRION|6}}.
It contains information related to the displacements (<code>displacements</code>) for [[phonons from finite differences]]. The data for each displacement (<code>data-N</code>), and symmetry information (<code>symmetry</code>). To generate or use the [[vaspcheckfd.h5]] file, refer to how to [[Restarting finite differences calculations|restart finite differences calculations]] with the {{TAG|CHECKPOINT_FD}} tag.

You can view the contents of the file using <code>h5ls vaspcheckfd.h5</code>, which contains the ''N'' displacements (in this case ''N''=4):
<syntaxhighlight lang="bash">
 data-1                   Group
 data-2                   Group
 data-3                   Group
 data-4                   Group
 ...
 displacements            Group
 symmetry                 Group
</syntaxhighlight>
